subject.title: feat(gateway): include produced messageId on chat final/aborted events

question: Should OpenClaw add `messageId` as the supported stable transcript identity on public gateway `final` and `aborted` chat events?
rationale: This creates a new externally consumed gateway protocol contract and client deduplication guarantee; source review can assess the implementation but cannot establish maintainer intent to support that API long term.

options.title: Sponsor the additive field
options.body: Adopt the optional field as the supported gateway deduplication contract after real behavior proof confirms the complete path.

options.title: Keep transcript lookup external
options.body: Decline the new protocol contract and retain transcript refetching or another existing client-owned correlation strategy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the additive field
recommendation.body: Adopt the optional field as the supported gateway deduplication contract after real behavior proof confirms the complete path.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current terminal event builders and is the strongest recent owner of the affected public gateway surface.
